استتبعا (form X)
# اِسْتَتْبَعَا (istatbaʕā) /is.tat.ba.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# اِسْتَتْبِعَا (istatbiʕā) /is.tat.bi.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
